what: [LOUD] [NEVER VERIFIED] MI-303. THE CAUSE OF THE DEAD DECISION CHANNEL IS FOUND, MEASURED AND REPAIRED, AND NOT ONE PROMPT HAS BEEN OBSERVED ARRIVING SINCE -- those are different facts and only the first holds. Telegram caps sendMessage's text at 4096 CHARACTERS and render_decision_prompt had NO length budget anywhere; send_telegram_direct RAISES on a non-2xx; the sweep caught that into a bare `failed += 1`; and the error string went only to the systemd journal, whose retention this repo has itself measured at ~30 minutes. So the channel failed permanently while reporting every health field good. THE PARTITION, over the COMPLETE population of 33 decision requests in docs/claude/work/objects/*.yaml cross-checked against the live marker file (20 markers): 0 of 5 over-cap requests had EVER been delivered, against 20 of 20 delivered markers all UNDER the cap. Unanswered AND over cap = 4 -- EXACTLY the receipt's candidates 4 / failed 4 on 46 of 47 recoverable runs. POSITIVE CONTROL, in situ on the receipt: the largest prompt ever delivered is 3815 chars, and the 47th run reads candidates 5 / failed 4 / prompted_choice 1 -- a 3815-char newcomer went out cleanly on the very same run the four over-cap ones failed. THE FOUR UNDELIVERED: DEC-20260917-SCALP-MARGIN-BOUND-SIZING (5463), DEC-20260913-FOUR-LEG-DISPOSITION (4738), DEC-20260917-NETTING-ATTRIBUTION-EVIDENCE-IS-DROPPABLE (4569), DEC-20260912-LOUD-FLAG-TRIAGE (4184). [!] THE SECOND FINDING IS THE MORE GENERAL ONE AND IS WHY THIS ROW EXISTS RATHER THAN A CLOSED BACKLOG LINE: the sweep wrote a durable receipt on EVERY run and NOTHING READ IT. Detection was never the missing half -- the receipt had the numbers all along. WHAT SHIPPED (PR TBD, Tier-2, landing: hold): the render is bounded as a POST-CONDITION for every input, dropping by load-bearingness (context first, then option implications, the question LAST) and saying so in the body while naming the object YAML; `failure_kinds` + a redacted `failure_detail` name WHY per request; and `sweep_outcome` is registered with collapsed-state-guard as telegram_decisions.sweep_outcome with a real reader in src/runtime/decision_channel_alert.py that pages through outcomes.jsonl. [!] MERGED IS NOT DEPLOYED, DEPLOYED IS NOT DELIVERED, AND DELIVERED IS NOT ANSWERED. It needs a Tier-2 merge, an ict-telegram-bot.service restart, and then a human.
